callLine: The steward has walked over from the Outpost and is waiting at your gate. The hall is open, and everyone is there.
toast: Friends, neighbours, hold your cups. The hall is mended, and the valley is tended from the hills to the shore.
Not one corner of it is wanting. We drink to the one who did it.

greencoat.name: Old Greencoat
greencoat.line: A fine valley. There is more country over the ridge, mind, when you are ready for it.

guests.name: The smith
guests.line: Every tool I sold you came home hard used. Good.

guests.name: The inn keeper
guests.line: The kitchen is yours, any evening.

guests.name: The store keeper
guests.line: You paid in full and in good seed. I will miss the haggling.

guests.name: The healer
guests.line: May you need me less than I hope you do.

guests.name: The librarian
guests.line: I shall write this down. Quietly, so as not to spoil it.

guests.name: The carpenter
guests.line: Sound beams, sound hall, sound neighbour.

guests.name: The hat-maker
guests.line: I made your crown. You made it mean something.

guests.name: The young adults
guests.line: We carried the cups ourselves. Do not tell the inn keeper.

guests.name: The retired couple
guests.line: We watched the hall go up the first time. This is better.

guests.name: The gardener
guests.line: Your rows were straight. I checked.

guests.name: The keeper of the farmstead
guests.line: The hens send their regards, loudly.

guests.name: The smith dwarf
guests.line: The mountain ran quiet today. It approves.

guests.name: The stonekeeper
guests.line: Bridges hold. So do people, with care.

guests.name: The trainer
guests.line: You hit harder than you did in spring. Sit down, eat.

guests.name: The fisher
guests.line: The river says well done, and wants its bait back.

guests.name: The odd elf
guests.line: I saw this coming on the tide. Naturally.

guests.name: The hermit
guests.line: I came down for this. Do not make it a habit of mine.

choices.label: Wave it off: everyone helped.
choices.reply: Hush now. Take the praise and pass the bread.

choices.label: Raise a cup and thank them all.
choices.reply: There. A proper answer. Cups up, everyone.

choices.label: Say nothing, and smile.
choices.reply: Ha. The quiet ones have always run this valley.

closing: Eat, rest, and tend your farm. The valley will keep.
